fonts.display: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Instrument Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

palette.name: Page Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card-on-canvas, light text on dark surfaces — the warm white that carries the entire monochrome system

palette.name: Hairline Border
palette.role: Dividers, card borders, image frames, icon outlines — the most-used stroke in the system, defines spatial structure

palette.name: Card Surface
palette.role: Elevated card backgrounds, secondary surface — sits one step above canvas to create grouping without shadow

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary body text, headings, icon strokes — slightly cooler than Graphite, reserved for typography not surfaces

palette.name: Pencil
palette.role: Secondary body text, descriptions, subhead copy

palette.name: Faint Graphite
palette.role: Muted helper text, tertiary metadata, inactive nav items
